bottleneck_observation: At 100 agents: zero contention, single Postgres instance handles transactions comfortably. At 1,000 agents: COUNT(*) aggregations on calls and partial index contention on idx_agents_available begin elevating p95 latency. At 10,000 agents: Postgres write throughput on provider_events and dial_decisions becomes the primary limiter; remedied by maintained in-DB counters, batched event ingestion transactions (50-100/commit), and daily table partitioning.
